lines.translation: The Guru instructs His wandering Sikhs;
if they go astray, He sets them on the right path.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਖਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: tis gur sev sadaa din raatee dukh bha(n)jan sa(n)g sakhaataa he ||13||
lines.translation: So serve the Guru, forever, day and night; He is the Destroyer of pain - He is with you as your companion. ||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kee bhagat karahi kiaa praanee ||
lines.translation: O mortal being, what devotional worship have you performed to the Guru?
Even Brahma, Indra and Shiva do not know it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਉ ਲਖੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਖਸੇ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: satigur alakh kahahu kiu lakheeai jis bakhase tisahi pachhaataa he ||14||
lines.translation: Tell me, how can the unknowable True Guru be known? He alone attains this realization, whom the Lord forgives. ||14||
One who has love within, obtains the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.
One who enshrines love for the Word of the Guru's Bani, meets with Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਬਾਈ ਘਟਿ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: ahinis niramal jot sabaaee ghat deepak guramukh jaataa he ||15||
lines.translation: Day and night, the Gurmukh sees the immaculate Divine Light everywhere; this lamp illuminates his heart. ||15||
The food of spiritual wisdom is the supremely sweet essence.
Whoever tastes it, sees the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਨਸਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥
lines.transliteration: darasan dekh mile bairaagee man manasaa maar samaataa he ||16||
lines.translation: Beholding His Darshan, the unattached one meets the Lord; subduing the mind's desires, he merges into the Lord. ||16||
Those who serve the True Guru are supreme and famous.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tin ghat ghat a(n)tar braham pachhaanaa ||
lines.translation: Deep within each and every heart, they recognize God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੭॥੫॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak har jas har jan kee sa(n)gat deejai jin satigur har prabh jaataa he ||17||5||11||
lines.translation: Please bless Nanak with the Lord's Praises, and the Sangat, the Congregation of the Lord's humble servants; through the True Guru, they know their Lord God. ||17||5||11||
Maaroo, First Mehl:
The True Lord is the Creator of the Universe.
He established and contemplates the worldly sphere.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aape karataa kar kar vekhai saachaa veparavaahaa he ||1||
lines.translation: He Himself created the creation, and beholds it; He is True and independent. ||1||
He created the beings of different kinds.
The two travellers have set out in two directions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਵਿਣੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: gur poore vin mukat na hoee sach naam jap laahaa he ||2||
lines.translation: Without the Perfect Guru, no one is liberated. Chanting the True Name, one profits. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੜਹਿ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਪਰੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: paRahi manamukh par bidh nahee jaanaa ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs read and study, but they do not know the way.
They do not understand the Naam, the Name of the Lord; they wander, deluded by doubt.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੈ ਕੈ ਵਢੀ ਦੇਨਿ ਉਗਾਹੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਾ ਗਲਿ ਫਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: lai kai vadhee den ugaahee duramat kaa gal phaahaa he ||3||
lines.translation: They take bribes, and give false testimony; the noose of evil-mindedness is around their necks. ||3||
They read the Simritees, the Shaastras and the Puraanas;
they argue and debate, but do not know the essence of reality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚ ਸੂਚੇ ਸਚੁ ਰਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: vin gur poore tat na paaeeai sach sooche sach raahaa he ||4||
lines.translation: Without the Perfect Guru, the essence of reality is not obtained. The true and pure beings walk the Path of Truth. ||4||
All praise God and listen, and listen and speak.
He Himself is wise, and He Himself judges the Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: jin kau nadar kare prabh apanee guramukh sabad salaahaa he ||5||
lines.translation: Those whom God blesses with His Glance of Grace become Gurmukh, and praise the Word of the Shabad. ||5||
Many listen and listen, and speak the Guru's Bani.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਕਹੀਐ ਕੋ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sun kaheeai ko a(n)t na jaanee ||
lines.translation: Listening and speaking, no one knows His limits.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਬੁਧਿ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kau alakh lakhaae aape akath kathaa budh taahaa he ||6||
lines.translation: He alone is wise, unto whom the unseen Lord reveals Himself; he speaks the Unspoken Speech. ||6||
At birth, the congratulations pour in;
the ignorant sing songs of joy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਨਮੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਰਪਰ ਮਰਣਾ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਪਇਆ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: jo janamai tis sarapar maranaa kirat paiaa sir saahaa he ||7||
lines.translation: Whoever is born, is sure to die, according to the destiny of past deeds inscribed upon his head by the Sovereign Lord King. ||7||
Union and separation were created by my God.
Creating the Universe, He gave it pain and pleasure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਭਏ ਨਿਰਾਲੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੀਲੁ ਸਨਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: dukh sukh hee te bhae niraale guramukh seel sanaahaa he ||8||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs remain unaffected by pain and pleasure; they wear the armor of humility. ||8||
The noble people are traders in Truth.
They purchase the true merchandise, contemplating the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਵਖਰੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚੈ ਓਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa vakhar jis dhan palai sabad sachai omaahaa he ||9||
lines.translation: One who has the wealth of the true commodity in his lap, is blessed with the rapture of the True Shabad. ||9||
The false dealings lead only to loss.
The trades of the Gurmukh are pleasing to God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸਾਬਤੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ ਚੂਕਾ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਫਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: poo(n)jee saabat raas salaamat chookaa jam kaa phaahaa he ||10||
lines.translation: His stock is safe, and his capital is safe and sound. The noose of Death is cut away from around his neck. ||10||
